pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown regions with jagged, stellate, or irregular polygonal edges. Edge gradients are moderately sharp against the lighter interstices. Patch area decreases and morphology becomes more fragmented on the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-tan interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit trivalent or quadrivalent configurations. Corridor pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with localized widening at intersection nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck exhibits a continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile consisting of dark brown hair tufts against the background.
